title: Day 23/28 - Setup Azure Monitoring And Alerting With Terraform
description:
🚀 Azure Monitoring and Alerting with Terraform—DevOps Deep Dive! 

Welcome to Day 23/28 of the Azure Terraform Full Course. In this video, We'll walk through a powerful DevOps mini-project that demonstrates how to set up robust monitoring and alerting infrastructure using Terraform and Azure. Perfect for cloud engineers, DevOps professionals, and infrastructure enthusiasts looking to level up their cloud management skills!

📘 What You'll Learn:
- Create a complete Azure infrastructure from scratch using Terraform
- Set up networking components, including VNET, subnet, and VM
- Implement advanced firewall rules for secure infrastructure
- Configure sophisticated monitoring alerts for critical metrics
- Create action groups to respond to infrastructure events
- Perform stress testing to validate monitoring setup
